items.titleZh: 皮亚斯特里谈巴库一号弯锁死：「确实让我措手不及」，本有望登台
items.summaryZh: 皮亚斯特里开局在一号弯超越勒克莱尔升至第二，并一度顶住维斯塔潘和哈贾尔；第一次安全车重启后被维斯塔潘超越，第二次重启后又遭哈贾尔施压，下一圈防守一号弯时出现双轮锁死，冲进缓冲区后名次大跌，最终列第14。「上半场非常鼓舞人心，之后就崩了……我得弄清楚锁死是怎么回事，因为它确实让我措手不及。」（来源：Formula 1）
items.originalTitle: ‘Certainly took me by surprise’ – Oscar Piastri reflects on Azerbaijan GP result after mistake
detailZh: 迈凯伦在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上过得十分艰难，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里和兰多·诺里斯都没有拿到积分。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里承认，那次可能让他失去阿塞拜疆大奖赛领奖台的锁死「确实让我措手不及」；这一天迈凯伦一分未得。
在环绕巴库历史街区的51圈比赛中，皮亚斯特里前半程表现强势，开局在第一个弯角超越夏尔·勒克莱尔升至第二。
随后这位迈凯伦车手顶住了来势汹汹的马克斯·维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈贾尔，两位红牛车手在比赛初段都展现出强劲速度。
在两次安全车中的第一次期间进站后，皮亚斯特里仍保持第二，但重启时没能守住维斯塔潘，跌至第三。
第二次安全车因第一个弯角发生的一起碰撞而出动，迈凯伦队友兰多·诺里斯卷入其中；重启时皮亚斯特里再次遭到身后的压力，这次来自哈贾尔。
他起初挡住了这位法国车手，但在下一圈进入一号弯时采取防守路线，结果出现双轮锁死，冲进缓冲区，名次大幅下滑。
「就是失望。显然，我觉得第一段和比赛前半程非常鼓舞人心，但从那以后就有点崩了。」最终列第14名的皮亚斯特里说。
「锁死的事我需要弄清楚发生了什么，因为它确实让我措手不及。我得去看一看，但最后没拿到成绩，显然非常令人失望。」
皮亚斯特里2026赛季至今过得很艰难，只登上过两次领奖台，最近一次还是5月的迈阿密站；而诺里斯在此前五站比赛中赢了两场。
尽管错失成绩，皮亚斯特里仍对自己在巴库整个周末的表现感到鼓舞，因为他重新回到了车阵前列。
「我觉得等尘埃落定，这个周末会有很多积极的东西。」他说。
「我觉得昨天的排位不错，总体上我感觉舒服多了——也许不是更舒服，而是对我需要怎么驾驭这台车有了更明确的方向。
「积极的方面有很多，只是最后没有积分、没有奖杯，显然会很难受。」
（来源：Formula 1 官网）
detailEn: McLaren suffered a difficult Azerbaijan Grand Prix as neither Oscar Piastri or Lando Norris scored points.

Oscar Piastri admits that the lock-up which potentially cost the Australian driver a podium in the Azerbaijan Grand Prix "certainly took me by surprise", on a day where McLaren failed to score a point.
Piastri had enjoyed a strong first half to the 51-lap race around Baku's historic streets, overtaking Charles Leclerc for second through the opening corner.
The McLaren driver then held off the charging Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar as both Red Bull drivers showed strong pace early on.
Piastri maintained second when pitting under the first of two Safety Cars, but at the restart, he was unable to hold Verstappen behind and dropped to third.

A second Safety Car was called after a collision at the opening corner, involving McLaren team mate Lando Norris, and Piastri once again faced pressure from behind at the restart, this time from Hadjar.
Having initially rebuffed the Frenchman, Piastri went defensive into Turn 1 on the following lap, suffering a double lock-up that sent him into the run-off area and down the order.

"Just disappointed. Obviously I think the first stint and the first half of the race was very encouraging and then from there on, it kind of unravelled," said Piastri, who was eventually classified in P14.
"The lock-up I need to understand what happened because it certainly took me by surprise. I need to go and have a look, but obviously very disappointing not to have a result at the end."
Piastri has endured a difficult season so far in 2026, taking just two podiums with the last one coming at Miami in May, while Norris has taken two wins from the previous five races.
Despite missing out on the result, Piastri was encouraged by his performance over the weekend in Baku having been back towards the front of the field.
"I think once the dust settles there will be a lot of positives from this weekend," he said.
"I think Qualifying yesterday was good, I think in general I felt much more comfortable, well maybe not more comfortable but I've had more direction on what I need to do with the car.
"There's plenty of positives it just hurts obviously when you don't have any points or a trophy at the end."

Source: Formula 1 (formula1.com). Original article: https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/certainly-took-me-by-surprise-piastri-reflects-on-azerbaijan-gp-result-after-mistake.6THrL3hQt1nTOMgRqVOfmf

items.titleZh: 哈贾尔伤愈复出即登台：「第一个真正靠纯速度拿到的领奖台」
items.summaryZh: 红牛车手伊萨克·哈贾尔夏休训练时手腕受伤，缺席了赞德沃特、蒙扎和马德里赛道三站，巴库复出后排位第四、正赛第三。这是他F1生涯第三个领奖台，但他认为是第一个「靠纯速度」拿到的——此前两次分别受益于2025年荷兰站诺里斯退赛（当时效力小红牛）和今年摩纳哥站加斯利受罚。（来源：Formula 1）
items.originalTitle: Isack Hadjar hails ‘first proper podium’ with P3 in Baku after ‘very long six weeks’ on the sidelines
detailZh: 伊萨克·哈贾尔伤愈复出，在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上跑出令人印象深刻的表现并登上领奖台。
红牛车手伊萨克·哈贾尔在「非常漫长的六周」休战后完成复出，并在巴库城市赛道登上领奖台，赛后笑容满面。
哈贾尔在夏休期间训练时弄伤了手腕，过去一个月缺席了赞德沃特、蒙扎和全新的马德里赛道三站比赛。
不过，这位法国车手获准在阿塞拜疆重返赛场，他在练习中逐步提速，随后排位第四，正赛一路跑到第三。
这是哈贾尔在F1的第三个领奖台，但他认为这是第一个「靠纯速度」拿到的——此前他曾在代表小红牛出战2025年荷兰大奖赛时受益于兰多·诺里斯退赛，今年早些时候又在摩纳哥因皮埃尔·加斯利受罚而获益。
哈贾尔赛后满脸喜色地分享感受：「我很开心。这六周非常漫长，差不多有六周没享受过了。
「我觉得这是复出的正确时机，我感觉状态很强。这个周末我真的是一步一步来。这条赛道很容易一下子就撞墙，而我不需要那样，我需要的是建立信心。这是一个非常缓慢的积累过程，但它把我带到了这里。
「能拿到第一个真正靠纯速度的领奖台，我非常非常开心，非常非常高兴。」
更让哈贾尔振奋的是，正在恢复中的手腕在周六下午的51圈比赛里经受住了考验——而2026赛季繁忙的收官阶段即将到来。
「我完全满意，」他说，「虽然有点麻，但我很开心。我非常期待再次比赛。接下来的赛程会非常密集，我等不及要去雪邦了。」
（来源：Formula 1 官网）
detailEn: Isack Hadjar marked his return from injury with an impressive drive to the podium in the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
Red Bull driver Isack Hadjar was all smiles after completing his comeback from a “very long six weeks” on the sidelines with a podium finish at the Baku City Circuit.
Hadjar missed events at Zandvoort, Monza and the all-new Madring track over the last month, having injured his wrist while training in the summer break.
However, the Frenchman got the green light to compete again in Azerbaijan, where he gradually built his speed throughout practice before qualifying fourth and racing his way to third place.

It marked Hadjar’s third podium in F1, but the first that he feels was earned “on pure pace”, given that he gained from Lando Norris’ retirement at the 2025 Dutch Grand Prix, while representing Racing Bulls, and from Pierre Gasly’s penalties in Monaco earlier this year.
Sharing his thoughts post-race, Hadjar beamed: “I’m happy. It’s been a very long six weeks. It’s been like six weeks since I enjoyed myself.

“I think it was the right time to come back. I felt strong. This weekend I really took it step by step. It’s a track where you can end up in the wall really quickly, and I didn’t need that, to gain the confidence. It was a very slow build-up, but it brought me here.
“I’m very, very happy for an actual first proper podium on pure pace. I’m very, very delighted.”
Hadjar was further boosted by his recovering wrist holding up well across 51 laps of racing on Saturday afternoon – as a busy final phase of the 2026 season looms.

“I’m completely satisfied,” he said. “Even though it’s a bit numb, I’m happy. I’m really looking forward to getting racing [again]. It’s going to be a very packed schedule. I can’t wait to be in Sepang.”

Source: Formula 1 (formula1.com). Original article: https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/hadjar-hails-first-proper-podium-with-p3-in-baku-after-very-long-six-weeks-on-the-sidelines.3B3LcWHpym034tQVwdIQSf

items.summaryZh: 因排位出问题从第八位起步的维斯塔潘说，第一段中性胎「抓地远不如软胎，只能想办法活下来」；安全车来得正是时候，换上软胎后「快了一大截」，他也在第一次重启时超越皮亚斯特里升至第二。收官阶段他始终在拉塞尔身后约一秒，最终仅以十分之一秒之差落败。「我把能用的办法都用上了。」（来源：Formula 1）
items.originalTitle: ‘I was trying everything’ – Max Verstappen gives verdict after missing out on Azerbaijan GP victory
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上离赛季首胜只有一步之遥。
马克斯·维斯塔潘承认，为了在巴库街道上拿下胜利，他「把所有办法都试过了」，但这位红牛车手最终仅以十分之一秒之差不敌乔治·拉塞尔。
由于排位出现问题，这位荷兰车手只能懊恼地从第八位出发参加周六的51圈比赛，但他用中性胎很快就开始追赶。
升至第三后，维斯塔潘在两次安全车重启中的第一次超越了奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的迈凯伦，升到第二，从而得以在收官阶段挑战领跑的拉塞尔。
「从第八位起步，我知道不会那么简单，但我们相当顺利地一路追进了前三，只是第一段非常棘手。」这位四届世界冠军说。
「那套中性胎就是不太行，没有我觉得软胎所拥有的抓地力，所以那一段我只是在努力活下来，尽量跟住那些用软胎的车手。
「我觉得那次安全车来得正是时候，大家都能进站换上软胎。一换上软胎，感觉就好多了，简直快了一大截。
「我觉得这一点也体现在，乔治和我换上软胎后，我们把其他所有人甩开了很多。」
最后几圈，维斯塔潘在主直道上始终保持在拉塞尔身后约一秒的距离，红牛在这场比赛中拥有直线速度优势。
瓦尔特利·博塔斯撞车后15号弯出现黄旗，让维斯塔潘在最后一次冲向终点时获得了更强的尾流。但这位荷兰车手最终仅差十分之一秒，这意味着他在2026赛季仍未取得分站冠军。
「我把所有能用的办法都用上了。」维斯塔潘谈到超越拉塞尔的尝试时说，其间他还数次在16号弯入口擦到护墙。
「当然，最后一圈因为有黄旗，我觉得乔治出现了一点助推迟滞，所以他出15号弯时没能拉开，这给了我多一点机会，这也是为什么冲线会那么接近。我们一直只差一秒，彼此非常接近。」
（来源：Formula 1 官网）
detailEn: Max Verstappen came close to taking his first victory of the season at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
Max Verstappen admits he "was trying everything" to claim victory on the streets of Baku, the Red Bull driver eventually falling short by just one tenth against George Russell.
The Dutchman was left a frustrated eighth on the grid for Saturday's 51-lap race after issues in Qualifying, but Verstappen quickly began to make progress with the medium tyre.
Moving into third, Verstappen demoted Oscar Piastri's McLaren for second at the first of two Safety car restarts, allowing him to challenge race leader Russell in the closing stages.
"Starting in P8 I knew it wasn't going to be that straightforward but we worked our way quite nicely up into the top three but that first stint was very tricky," said the four-time World Champion.
"That medium tyre was just not very good, not having the grip that I think the soft tyres had so was just trying to survive on that stint to try and stay with the guys on the soft.
"I think that Safety Car came at the right time for everyone to box onto that soft, because once we were on that soft tyre, it felt a lot better, just miles faster.
"I think that also showed once George and I were on the soft, we were pulling away quite a lot over everyone else."
Verstappen stayed on the cusp of a one second gap to Russell over the final laps down the main straight, with Red Bull enjoying straight-line speed during the race.

A yellow flag at Turn 15 after Valtteri Bottas crashed gifted Verstappen the chance to gain an even stronger slipstream on the run to the line for the final time. But the Dutchman ultimately fell short by just one tenth, meaning he has still yet to record a victory during the 2026 season.
"I was trying everything that I have available," said Verstappen in his quest to pass Russell, which included glancing the wall on the entry to Turn 16 several times.

"Of course on the last lap because there was a yellow, I think George picked up a bit of boost lag, so he didn't pull out of Turn 15 and that gave me a little bit more of an opportunity and that's why it was so close to the line. We were constantly one second, so we were very close to each other."

Source: Formula 1 (formula1.com). Original article: https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/i-was-trying-everything-verstappen-gives-verdict-after-missing-out-on-azerbaijan-gp-victory.6M9zlnYYDH8w4AnRIninDX

items.titleZh: 安东内利：巴库是「本季迄今最差周末」，第五名已是止损
items.summaryZh: 积分领跑者安东内利在巴库练习赛受技术问题困扰，排位第一节撞车出局，只能从第16位发车；正赛追到第五，但拉塞尔杆位夺冠，使他的积分领先从81分缩小到66分。「这种日子你只能对第五名感到满意。这显然是本季到目前为止最差的周末……排位失误后信心不高，今天就是止损。」（来源：Formula 1）
items.originalTitle: Kimi Antonelli vows to take lessons from ‘worst weekend of the season’ in Azerbaijan
detailZh: 基米·安东内利周六在巴库城市赛道上打了一场止损战，从第16位追到了第五。
基米·安东内利在巴库街道上经历了「本季最差的周末」，但他明确表示，阿塞拜疆大奖赛这个周末「教会了我很多」。
安东内利的周末一开始就在练习中受到技术问题的拖累，随后又在排位第一节戏剧性地撞车出局，只能从第16位发车，而队友乔治·拉塞尔拿到了杆位。
尽管安东内利在正赛日追到了第五，但拉塞尔从杆位到冠军的表现，意味着这位意大利车手在积分榜上的领先优势从81分被削减到66分。
谈到这场比赛和整个周末，安东内利说：「我觉得这是那种你只能对第五名感到满意的日子。显然，这是本季到目前为止最差的周末，而且差得很远。
「我就是……我感觉总是慢了一步，尤其是排位出现失误后，信心水平不高。今天的比赛我只是想……今天就是为了止损。
「我的速度不强，而且在安全车重启时（与哈斯的奥利·贝尔曼发生接触）之后，我的赛车带着很大的损伤，底板严重受损。
「在赛道上并不容易，但我已经尽了全力。」
接下来两个周末，F1将转战马来西亚和新加坡，赛季进入繁忙的收官阶段——安东内利希望阿塞拜疆只是前进路上的一个小插曲。
「我觉得这个周末教会了我很多，」他说，「我觉得这个周末很多时候……我也说不好，可能在心态上我也没有处在最好的节奏里。
「我会确保下周末我们回到应有的水平。」
（来源：Formula 1 官网）
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli was on a damage limitation exercise at the Baku City Circuit on Saturday, turning 16th into fifth.
Kimi Antonelli made clear that the Azerbaijan Grand Prix weekend “taught me a lot” after enduring his “worst weekend of the season” on Baku’s streets.

Antonelli’s start to the weekend was hampered by technical problems in practice before he dramatically crashed out in the opening phase of Qualifying – leaving him down in 16th on the grid, with team mate George Russell on pole.
While Antonelli recovered to fifth position on race day, Russell’s pole-to-victory drive means the Italian’s championship lead has been cut from 81 points to 66.
Reflecting on his race, and the event as a whole, Antonelli said: “I think it’s one of those days where you have to be happy with P5. Obviously it was the worst weekend, by far, of the season.
“I was just… I felt always a step behind, and especially with the mistake in Qualifying, the confidence level was not high. In today’s race I just tried to… today was about damage limitation.
“I didn’t have strong pace, and also after [contact with Haas’ Ollie Bearman at] the Safety Car restart I was carrying big damage, big floor damage.
“It was not easy out there, but I just did my best.”

F1 will move on to Malaysia and Singapore over the next two weekends, as the season heads into a busy final phase – and Antonelli is hopeful that Azerbaijan will turn out to be only a blip in the road.
“I think this weekend taught me a lot,” he said. “I think in many occasions this weekend… I don’t know, probably also with the mindset I was not in the best pace.
“I’ll just make sure that next weekend we get back at the right level.”
Source: Formula 1 (formula1.com). Original article: https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/antonelli-vows-to-take-lessons-from-worst-weekend-of-the-season-in-azerbaijan.2gFddBKt9w2Zp3y6deTe5r

items.originalTitle: George Russell ‘feels like myself again’ after ‘incredible’ pole-to-victory drive in Azerbaijan
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔周六在巴库城市赛道顶住了马克斯·维斯塔潘的猛烈追击，拿下个人2026赛季第三场胜利。
乔治·拉塞尔盛赞自己在阿塞拜疆度过了一个从头到尾都「不可思议」的周末：这位梅赛德斯车手在周四练习中排名第一，以统治级表现夺得杆位，最终拿下胜利，并借此把队友基米·安东内利在车手积分榜上的领先优势削减了15分。
拉塞尔来到本站时落后安东内利81分，他在冲向方格旗的较量中力压红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘，把差距缩小到66分；而这位年轻的意大利车手在第一节排位发生戏剧性事故后，正赛从第16位追到了第五。
这是拉塞尔自6月奥地利站以来的首个分站冠军，也是他2026赛季迄今的第三胜，而安东内利目前已经赢了8场。
「重回领奖台最高处的感觉太棒了，」拉塞尔赛后说，「我只想特别感谢我的车队，他们在艰难时刻一直相信我，帮我挺了过来。我为这个周末感到非常自豪。
「比赛前半段感觉相当顺利，一直在拉开差距，然后是安全车重启……当我看到马克斯在身后，我就想『这不会轻松』。他在比赛最后阶段开得非常出色。
「黄旗出来的时候（因为瓦尔特利·博塔斯撞车），我收了油，等我再踩下去时没有涡轮，所以也就没有动力。马克斯差点在终点线上超过我，那样就太可惜了。总的来说，这是一个不可思议的周末。」
被问到信心似乎已经回来时，拉塞尔补充说：「我想只是对我采用的这种新驾驶风格有了更多经验。夏休之后的每一场比赛，我都觉得自己越来越强。我感觉又更像我自己了，这真的很棒。」
至于在剩余分站中如何追赶安东内利，这位英国车手明确表达了自己的意图。
「每场都赢！这就是计划。」他笑着说，「我的队友这个赛季表现不可思议，几乎一直无懈可击，但现在到了关键时刻。
「我只会专注于自己。如果我能继续像这个周末一样发挥，无论赛季末发生什么，我都会很开心。这段时间对我来说非常艰难，现在我感觉自己已经走出来了。」
（来源：Formula 1 官网）
detailEn: George Russell fended off a charging Max Verstappen to claim his third victory of the 2026 season at the Baku City Circuit on Saturday.

George Russell hailed an “incredible” weekend from start to finish in Azerbaijan, with the Mercedes driver topping Thursday practice, charging to a dominant pole and ultimately securing victory – cutting team mate Kimi Antonelli’s championship lead by 15 points in the process.

Russell headed into the event 81 points behind Antonelli, but trimmed that gap to 66 by edging out Red Bull’s Max Verstappen in a dash to the chequered flag, while the young Italian recovered from 16th to fifth after a dramatic Q1 accident.
It marks Russell’s first Grand Prix victory since Austria in June, and his third of the 2026 season so far, comparing to the eight Antonelli has achieved up to this point.

“It’s amazing to be back on the top step of the podium,” Russell commented post-race. “I just want to say a big thanks to my team, because they continued to believe in me through tough moments, helped me come through it. I’m really proud to have had this weekend.

“The first half of the race felt pretty plain sailing, getting the gap, the Safety Car restart… When I saw Max behind, I thought, ‘It’s not going to be easy’. He drove incredibly at the end of the race.

“When the yellow flag came out [for Valtteri Bottas’ crash], I lifted off the power, and when I went back, I had no turbo, so then I had no power. Max almost got me at the line, so that would have been a real shame. All in all, an incredible weekend.”

Asked about his confidence seemingly returning, Russell added: “I think it’s just having more experience with this sort of new driving style that I’ve adopted. Every race since the [summer] break I feel like I’ve gone from strength to strength. I feel like more myself again, so that’s really great.”
As for how he plans to approach the remaining rounds of the championship, in his quest to overhaul Antonelli, the Briton made his intentions clear.
“Win every race! That’s the game plan,” he stated with a smile. “My team mate’s had an incredible season, he’s been pretty flawless throughout, but now we’re getting to crunch time.

“I’m just going to focus on myself. If I continue delivering performances like I’ve done this weekend, no matter what happens towards the end of the season, I’ll be happy. It’s been a really tough period for me, and now I feel like I’ve come through the other side.”

Source: Formula 1 (formula1.com). Original article: https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/russell-feels-like-myself-again-after-incredible-pole-to-victory-drive-in-azerbaijan.67QSi4tYiFh9PYkG2KSgIY
